description: EMT benchmarks for the DC networks, 800 V. simscape_emt_benchmarks.m builds each case in Simscape and tests/test_emt.py builds it with Electrisim's solver, both from this file. SI units.

long_cable.description: A source behind R and L energises, from rest, a 2 km cable as 10 pi sections into a resistive load; the far end is faulted at 0.5 ms.

cpl.description: A constant-power load on a capacitor C, behind a source's R and L, at 95 % and 105 % of its stability limit R C v0^2 / L, starting at its equilibrium; its power steps up 1 % at 2 ms.

cpl_profile.description: A constant-power load following a training-cycle profile - its power p_set times the profile, linearly interpolated between samples dt_profile apart, holding its last value - on a capacitor C behind a source's R and L, starting in its steady state at the profile's first value: its opening step from 0.9 to 0.75 pu, a ramp to 1.0 pu, a checkpoint at 0.3 pu, and back.

breaker.description: A source behind R and L feeds, from rest, a breaker (limiting inductor, switch and surge arrester), a cable and a resistive load; the load end is faulted at 1 ms and the breaker opens at a set time.
